description_en: Queries information about one or more custom images that have been created in a specified region
description_zh: 查询指定地域下一个或多个已创建的自定义镜像信息
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open list-custom-images --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --image-ids fe9c66133a9d4688872869726b520000_,_794c230fd3e64ea19f83f4d7a0ad0000 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --image-names test10000_,_test20000 --system-snapshot-id s-bp14m09pq80000g6 --data-snapshot-id s-acscasca0000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --resource-group-id rg-aek2bti7cf7yj2i --share false --instance-id ace0706b2ac4454d984295a942130000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCustomImages

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application servers. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html to query the list of supported regions
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. A client token is generated from your client and must be unique among different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The image IDs of the simple application servers. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 instance IDs. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 轻量应用服务器的镜像ID。取值可以由多个实例ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: image_ids

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 100.
Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

最大值：100。
默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the snapshot list.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
快照列表的页码。
默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The image names of the simple application servers. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 instance IDs. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 轻量应用服务器的镜像名称。取值可以由多个实例ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: image_names

parameters.help_en: The system cloud disk snapshot ID
parameters.name: system_snapshot_id

parameters.help_en: The data cloud disk snapshot ID
parameters.name: data_snapshot_id

fields.help_en: The tag key of the custom image. Valid values of the tag key length: 1 to 64. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 自定义镜像的标签键。标签键长度的取值范围：1~64。N 的取值范围：1~20
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the custom image. Valid values of the tag value length: 1 to 64. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 自定义镜像的标签值。标签值长度的取值范围：1~64。N 的取值范围：1~20
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags of the custom images
parameters.help_zh: 自定义镜像的标签列表
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query shared images. Valid values:

False: The response does not include shared images.

True: Only shared images are returned.

If this parameter is not specified, all images are returned by default
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询共享镜像。取值范围：

False：否。表示返回结果中不包括共享镜像。

True：是。表示只返回共享镜像。

不填则默认返回所有镜像
parameters.name: share

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the simple application server from which the image was created
parameters.help_zh: 镜像的来源轻量应用服务器实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

CreateInstances.description_zh: 使用镜像创建的实例信息

items.description_en: The instance ID of the instance created from the image

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the snapshot was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 快照创建时间。时间格式以ISO8601为标准，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

DataSnapshotId.description_en: The data cloud disk snapshot ID

DataSnapshotName.description_en: The name of the data cloud disk snapshot

InShare.description_en: Indicates whether the custom image is shared to ECS
InShare.description_zh: 自定义镜像是否共享至ECS

InShareUser.description_en: Indicates whether the custom image is shared across accounts
InShareUser.description_zh: 自定义镜像是否跨账号共享

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the simple application server from which the image was created
InstanceId.description_zh: 镜像的来源轻量应用服务器的实例ID

InstanceName.description_zh: 轻量应用服务器实例名称

Name.description_en: The name of the custom image

OsType.description_en: The operating system type of the image

RequiredDataDiskSize.description_zh: 镜像的数据盘大小，单位为GiB

RequiredSystemDiskSize.description_zh: 镜像的系统盘大小，单位为GiB

Status.description_en:
The status of the custom image. Valid values:

0: copying.

1: active.
2: unavailable.
3: creation failed.
4: creating

自定义镜像状态。取值范围：

0：复制中。

1：可用。
2：不可用。
3：创建失败。
4：创建中

SystemSnapshotId.description_en: The system cloud disk snapshot ID

SystemSnapshotName.description_en: The name of the system cloud disk snapshot

Tags.description_en: The tags of the custom images
Tags.description_zh: 自定义镜像的标签列表

Key.description_en: The tag key of the custom image

Value.description_en: The tag value of the custom image

UserId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the image owner
UserId.description_zh: 镜像拥有者的阿里云主账号ID

PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数
